services.desc: Take an exhilarating Bay Cruise and a trip to the world-famous Alcatraz, all in the same day! Once home to some of America’s most notorious criminals, the federal penitentiary that operated here from 1934 to 1963 brought a dark mystique to the Rock. To this day, Alcatraz is best known as one of the world’s most legendary prisons. See breathtaking views of the skyline, pass under the Golden Gate Bridge, pass a colony of sea lions, and even enjoy potential whale 1.5 Hours • All Ages • Buy one Alcatraz Tour + one Bay Sail

services.name: July 4th Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: 1.5 Hours About See San Francisco’s spectacular annual display of fireworks from the best place to watch—on the water, right below the action! Departing the dock from Pier 39 at 9:00pm in order to get into position just before the display begins at 9:30. We will be on the water until the end of the fireworks, which is normally about 1.5 hours total. Departure Time Please arrive to Gate J about 20min early for check in. Please note: GIVE YOURSELF EXTRA TIME TO PARK/ARRIVE. Also, we are unloading Sunset trips and cleaning the boats just prior, but the crew will be sure to board you in 1.5 Hours • All Ages Welcome • See it all from the best seat in the City!

services.name: SailGP
services.desc: 2 Hours About Includes 1 drink per ticket (beer/wine/non-alcoholic). Experience the next generation high-speed foiling SailGP sailing series up close and personal with Adventure Cat for the first ever race in San Francisco! For 2 hours you'll have front row seats to watch athletes from all over the world race head to head on newly redefined F50 wing-sail catamarans at speeds of over 50 knots (that's 60mph!).
